label: Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 Hits
delta: 'SWIM' in 11th consecutive week on Hot 100 (No. 55, chart dated June 6); 8th consecutive week at No. 1 on Billboard Global (Excl. US) — tying 'Dynamite' for BTS's longest-ever run on that chart. No. 4 on Billboard Global 200 (up from No. 10). All 13 ARIRANG vocal tracks on global charts for 10th straight week.

label: Billboard 200 No. 1 Albums
delta: ARIRANG held 3 consecutive #1 weeks (K-pop first); now 9 consecutive charting weeks in total — longest sustained K-pop run in Billboard 200 history. ARIRANG at No. 8 Billboard 200 (chart ~May 25). All 13 vocal tracks remain active on global charts.
